description: MainActivity.java is the primary activity class for an Android application. It initializes the UI, manages fragment transactions, handles menu options for logging visibility, and sets up a custom logging chain. The class extends SampleActivityBase and interacts with fragments and views related to a sliding tabs UI component.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity class managing UI initialization, fragment transactions, menu interactions, and logging setup for the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates layout, and adds the SlidingTabsColorsFragment if savedInstanceState is null.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML layout.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Updates menu item visibility and title based on UI state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling log visibility and updating ViewAnimator display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain, integrating custom log wrappers and filters, and connects it to the UI log fragment.
